title: Enterprise Support: Disjoint export spending addition for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Disjoint export spending addition for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Add the posted recognized eligible supported spending in USD amount to baseline vCPU-hours multiplied by the effective cloud rate; these are disjoint provider export buckets.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: Suppose recognized spending is hypothetically USD 70 and the disjoint baseline has 100 vCPU-hours at an effective cloud rate of USD 0.40. Baseline spending is USD 40 and eligible spending is USD 110. The recognized USD 70 is already monetary and is not multiplied by the cloud rate again.
